response.justification: Broad, long-tenured engineer with genuine high-throughput distributed systems exposure (Sociomantic/dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests per second with async I/O, fibers, caching) and current hands-on work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which maps directly to the AI-native mindset requirement. Strong TypeScript/Node depth, craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development), and a Staff-level title today. However, Python — a stated must-have — is absent from the skills list and employment history, with the deep systems work done in DLang rather than the target stack. The resume also reads as full-stack/product-oriented rather than architecture-at-scale, with little evidence of technical strategy ownership, cross-functional stakeholder leadership, or on-call/incident-response ownership. Worth a screen to probe Python fluency and scope of technical influence.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work at ad-tech scale
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP/developer tooling experience
Strong TypeScript/Node depth plus polyglot breadth and testing/CI craftsmanship
concerns: No demonstrated Python, an explicit must-have for the role
Limited evidence of technical strategy, architecture ownership, or stakeholder leadership at Staff scope
No stated operational ownership, monitoring, or on-call/incident-response experience
